description: external-windows-wma10pro-cbr-stereo-44k-128.wma written without the length prefix by make_wma_pro_no_length_prefix.py: the same frames, joined without their prefixes and cut into packets again, and the length prefix bit of the decode flags cleared. Not an encoder's output; it holds the frames of Media Foundation's transcoder (see that file's provenance) in the layout of a writer without the prefix, so the frames that start in the last packet, which a decoder reads, are covered.
